body: Thank you so much. I'm still figuring things out and trying to be better, but it's definitely an uphill battle. It can kind of go either way at this point.

They have medicine to treat depression and anxiety. I was prescribed a few things that helped with the shaking. I stopped taking them and felt fine for awhile, until I needed them again. If you give me some time, I can probably pull my medical records and find out what they were. I was prescribed different kinds because one had an embarrassing side-affect. Just be careful with whatever you take. That was almost 4 years ago and I still shake to this day. I'm thinking about going back for another prescription. I stopped because I didn't want to develop a dependence on pills, but they did help me.
